notes: Beta: a playlist can now follow a YouTube playlist as well as Spotify and Apple Music — and YouTube is the most accurate of the three, because it names the actual videos instead of song titles the app then has to go and search for. Make the playlist collaborative and anyone you share it with can add music to your station just by adding it there. Also in this build: the running order is built as the station plays rather than shuffled once at the start, so a song that's just finished downloading can turn up next; listeners can request a song from your station's page (switch it on per station in Settings); song titles now come from the music files themselves, so punctuation and full credits come back; and Tools → Tidy up the gaps measures the silence at each end of every song so playback skips it.
